display.explanation: Mothering Sunday gives thanks for the care we receive and invites prayer for those who nurture others.
display.prompt: Pray for mothers and all who offer care, and for those for whom this day is difficult.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: ‘As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you, and you shall be comforted in Jerusalem,’ says the Lord. Isaiah 66:13

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence
sentences.text: Jerusalem above is free, and she is our mother. Galatians 4:26

collects.text:
Everloving God,
your care for us is greater
even than a mother’s love for her child;
teach us to value a mother’s love
and see in it an expression of your grace,
that we may ever feel more deeply your love for us
in Christ Jesus our Saviour.

Blessed are you, God of strength and patience;
yours is the love our mothers showed us,
yours the care we need;
as we learn to care for one another
and to share your love,
may it be with our mother we share it
first of all.
